results.title: Fresh Indian wrestling squad heads for U-23 Worlds amid visa uncertainty
results.description: India will field a fresh squad at the U-23 World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas from October 12, following national trials. However, visa problems have cast uncertainty over the participation of wrestlers in the Greco-Roman and women’s categories
